# Nakshora

> The modern, ultra-fast, utility-first CSS framework with a JIT compiler. Built by Rizwan Rahim Chowdhury (RRC Development). MIT licensed.

Nakshora compiles only the CSS your project actually uses: 11,417 utilities across 35 categories (layout, spacing, sizing, flexbox, grid, typography, 22 color palettes × 11 shades, backgrounds, borders, effects, transforms, transitions, animations), plus built-in design-paradigm components (glassmorphism, neon cyber, brutalism, minimalism, skeletons) and five theme presets. Zero runtime JS — pure CSS output.

## Packages

- `@nakshora/core` — JIT CSS compiler & engine (zero dependencies)
- `@nakshora/cli` — CLI: `nakshora init / build / dev / doctor / migrate / lsp / inspect / export:ai`
- `@nakshora/postcss` — PostCSS plugin (`@nakshora source;` / `@nakshora utilities;`)
- `@nakshora/vite-plugin` — Vite plugin (virtual module `import 'nakshora'`, HMR)

## Quick start

```bash
npm install -D @nakshora/vite-plugin
```

```js
// vite.config.js
import { nakshora } from '@nakshora/vite-plugin';
export default { plugins: [nakshora({ content: ['./index.html', './src/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx,vue}'] })] };
```

```js
// src/main.js
import 'nakshora';
```

```html
<button class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-600 transition">
  Click me
</button>
```

## Class grammar

- Color: `<util>-<palette>-<shade>` — `text-blue-500`, `bg-slate-900`, `border-rose-200`, `from-indigo-400` (22 palettes: slate gray zinc neutral stone red orange amber yellow lime emerald green teal cyan sky blue indigo violet purple fuchsia pink rose; shades 50–950)
- Spacing: key ∈ `0 px 0.5 1 1.5 2 2.5 3 3.5 4 5 6 7 8 9 10 11 12 14 16 20 24 28 32 36 40 44 48 56 64 72 80 96` (rem scale) — `p-4`, `mt-2`, `mx-6`, `gap-y-8`
- Responsive (mobile-first, 10 breakpoints): `xxs:` 200 · `xs:` 400 · `sm:` 640 · `md:` 768 · `lg:` 1024 · `xl:` 1280 · `2xl:` 1536 · `3xl:` 1920 · `4xl:` 2560 · `5xl:` 5000 — `md:grid-cols-2`; `max-md:` (max-width), `@md:` (container queries), `min-[900px]:`
- Variants (JIT mode, Tailwind v3.4 grammar, 155 total): `hover:` `focus:` `focus-visible:` `active:` `disabled:` `first:` `odd:` `group-hover:` `peer-checked:` `has-[…]:` `aria-*:` `data-*:` `supports-[…]:` `dark:` `print:` `motion-reduce:` `*:` `not-hover:` `starting:` — stack freely: `md:hover:bg-blue-600`, `dark:group-hover:text-white`
- Arbitrary values / properties / variants: `w-[37px]`, `bg-[#1e293b]`, `[mask-type:luminance]`, `[&>*]:p-2`; opacity modifiers `bg-blue-500/50`; `!` important
- Design components: `.glass` `.glass-light` `.glass-dark` `.neon-card` `.neon-btn` `.neon-glow` `.neon-text` `.brutalist-card` `.brutalist-btn` `.minimalist-card` `.minimalist-btn` `.skeleton-rect` `.skeleton-circle` `.skeleton-text` `.hover-lift` `.gradient-text` `.gradient-neon` `.gradient-pastel` `.gradient-nature` `.gradient-brutalist`
- Dark mode: `class="dark"` on `<html>` + `dark:` variants

## Key behavior

- JIT mode (default when `content` is configured) emits only used classes (typically 5–20 KB); full mode emits all base + responsive utilities (5,983 KB min / 133 KB brotli).
- `@apply`, `theme()`, `screen()` in author CSS; `@theme` / `@utility` / `@custom-variant` (Tailwind v4 syntax) extend the config from CSS.
- Tailwind v3.4 parity: 11,343 static + 1,338 dynamic classes byte-identical; official Tailwind plugins (typography, forms, aspect-ratio, container-queries) run unchanged. `npx nakshora migrate` ports a Tailwind project.
- Editor support: `npx nakshora lsp` (completion, hover, diagnostics, colours) for any LSP client.
- `safelist: []` for dynamically-built class names.
- Theme overrides deep-merge: `theme: { colors: { brand: { 500: '#6d28d9' } } }`.
- Every token is exposed as a CSS variable on `:root` (`--color-blue-500`, `--spacing-4`, …).
